name: Inbox Triage Desk
tagline: Puts every message in one of four lanes, with the actual ask quoted
description: Every message lands in one of four lanes - answer, hand off, put on the calendar, or keep for reference - and the actual request in each one is quoted so you see what is really being asked. Deadlines are pulled forward rather than buried, and a draft reply waits with the lane. Nothing is sent or archived without you.
author: Cypher0x9
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
